_comment: SCHEMA EXAMPLE ONLY — fake URLs. The real reference-blog list lives in sources.local.json, which is gitignored so those URLs never land in this public repo's history. Copy this file to sources.local.json and fill in the real sources.

sources.notes: A feed usually carries only the most recent 10-20 entries — right for a delta, wrong for a baseline. Hence baseline_endpoint below.
No feed found; the sitemap has the full history. Sitemap indexes are not followed — point at a leaf sitemap, not an index.

No feed or sitemap covers posts, so this scrapes the listing page. Fragile — watch for FAIL if it starts paginating. Set enabled:false to retire a source deliberately; never lower expected_min to silence a FAIL.
sources._ua_note: "browser" sends a browser user-agent, for hosts that 403 anything else. Check with: node scripts/blog.mjs scan --probe
